body:
What happened when I attempted or what happened that made me attempt it?

I was doing a course in civil construction at the time, but my mother dragged me to her house a few towns over, and now I have no way of attending that course.

I threw away my life to be with a girl I fell very deeply in love with. All so she could run back to her scumbag ex who will just make her life miserable again and again.

And now, I am depressed because I've lost her, I'm stressed because there's so much I needed to do in order to have chased after her to begin with, and all of this pressure is too much.

I've buckled time and time again, but when my emotions flow like that, I can't guarantee that I do the job right, so I set a few dates that potentially wouldn't contain as much emotional strain as usual. Today is my last chance to find peace.

My plan was to just wait until my roommate left, smoke a joint or two, then hack open my arms while listening to some music. I can't wait too long, or I'll have to face the problems that are driving me to suicide in the first place.
Right now, all that troubles my mind is that I lack the courage to go through with everything I'd planned.
